task: ADR-032 (Communications Management Plan Standard): approve, reject, or request revision

criteria.description: Tier 3 communications contract depending only on Scope: a matrix with audience, cadence, channel and owner, a rule that the record is not the channel, escalation, and confidentiality. One shared logit map on advise-communications-plan-decision; the deciding role (internal communications or marketing) is recorded with each pair and is not a second bandit. Floors and caps stay at the ADR-012 defaults.
Two alternatives rejected: ad hoc communication with no plan, and one organization-wide communication plan.
Names predictable reporting and a durable decision record, and the cost: authoring burden on small projects, with the lean pmp_section form as the mitigation.

Section 8 resolves the missing edge to stakeholder-engagement and defers generated status reports. Section 4.5 states that a change to Communications does not stale Stakeholder Engagement, and that the reviewer checks the pair.
